title: Futures book improvement programme (target: estimated live Sharpe 1.5+)

rules.equity_beta: allowed. A candidate that adds equity exposure may enter when it improves the book. Safeguard: the book may not get worse in 2010-17 or 2018-22 (2018-22 contains the 2022 bear market), so a pure bull-market bet fails; the ES/NQ beta share is reported for every candidate.
rules.evidence: backtest on 2010-22 (entry) and 2023-26 (judge), strict rule (+0.05 on 2023-26, no earlier period lower); then paper from 2026-10-01 (unseen). One month of paper says little; paper keeps running and is evaluated over months.
rules.no_stop: we keep working until the estimated live Sharpe is good enough for regular payouts. Instead of a stop rule a SWITCH rule: each data source gets a small pre-registered set of tests; when it is used up we move to a new source (new information), never back to re-tuning a tested idea after seeing its result.
rules.honesty: every test is pre-registered and counted; the planning Sharpe (after the luck haircut for all futures trials) is reported after every round; nothing changes the paper book without the user's OK.

sources.source: EIA weekly petroleum stocks (crude ex SPR, gasoline, distillate) and natural-gas storage
intraday 1-minute (ES, NQ, GC, CL owned; more via Databento after a cost quote)

methods_to_cover: session structure: opening range (5/15/30 min) breakout and failure, initial balance, overnight high / low
levels: PDH/PDL, PWH/PWL, overnight range, round numbers, VWAP and its bands
liquidity: sweep-and-reclaim of session / day levels, failed breakouts
trend-day vs range-day classification (first-hour range vs ATR) with continuation or fade
pullbacks to VWAP / EMA in trend, gap fill / gap-and-go at the cash open
time-of-day exits (end of session, fixed hold) vs fixed R targets vs trailing
queued_research.protocol: every family pre-registered before any result; dev 2018-22, judge 2023-26 once; realistic futures costs (1 tick slippage + commission per side); count every trial; strict rule for a book (+0.05, no period lower); placebo / neighbourhood checks for passes; the user's own rules (template in chat 2026-11-02) are tested first as a separate pre-registered set
queued_research.lessons_carried_over: crypto R8-R12: generic level / session / FVG entries had no directional information and tight stops lose to costs; prefer wider (session-based) stops and conditions with a mechanism (opening auction, overnight inventory, VWAP benchmarking by institutions)
queued_research.target: an intraday futures book suitable for intraday prop firms (no overnight), judged on its own and as a diversifier of the crypto / CFD accounts
queued_research.start: after the crypto challenge is running and the CFD paper gate (mid-December 2026) is decided
